node.statement: By the compressed-product notation used in def-ha-map, a dot b=Co_{A,C}(ab). The exact compression-dagger identity from lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, followed by the involution law (ab)^dagger=b^dagger a^dagger, gives (a dot b)^dagger=Co_{C,A}(b^dagger a^dagger)=b^dagger dot a^dagger. The corner membership needed in the last product is node 1.2.1; no associativity or estimate is used.
